name: idtap-contract

versionPolicy.assert: Each implementation keeps a constant CONTRACT_VERSION and asserts it equals contract.json `version` in its conformance suite (see README 'Versioning').
versionPolicy.minor: bumped when wire semantics change (a client built against an older minor must not load newer data without the matching heal); clients assert exact match.
versionPolicy.patch: reserved for fixture/doc additions that change no semantics.

changelog.0.2.0: PROP-6 vibrato v2: vibObj is {rate, extentStart, extentEnd, vertOffset, phase}; v1 {periods, vertOffset, initUp, extent} accepted as LEGACY and healed losslessly; canonical form emits vibObj only when id == 13 (PROP-6b).
changelog.0.1.0: initial contract: PROP-1 ruleSet, PROP-2 dates/collections, PROP-3 chikari; 10 entities.

description: Language-neutral serialization contract (JSON Schemas + golden fixtures) for the IDTAP data model, shared by idtap (TS) and idtap-api (Python).

raga.notes: Yaman-only until RAGA-1..3 in DIVERGENCES.md are resolved

trajectory.notes: vibObj sub-schema done (PROP-6 v2 + LEGACY v1); Articulation/Automation are $ref'd to their own schemas

status: model complete — 10 entities; awaiting owner review of DIVERGENCES.md before applying fixes
